title: Luxury Space with Heated Pool/Walk to Broadway
description:
Looking for a brand-new, thoughtfully designed, modern mid-rise? This is the perfect fit! This downtown condo is equipped with a swimming pool, fitness room, and a gated parking garage. Spend the day exploring many of the popular restaurants, hot spots, coffee shops and bars within walking distance. Then return to a modern paradise where the fun continues! This 2 bedroom unit sleeps 6 comfortably.

The space
We are proud to say this property is thoroughly cleaned and disinfected after each stay according to the protocols set forth by the CDC.   

This spot was both thoughtfully and functionally designed. 

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi
✔ Air Conditioning
✔ Heating
✔ Free Parking

Located at the sophisticated, brand-new Illume Mid-Rise, this 2BR / 2BA unit combines modern design with comfort. Endless details are found throughout the stylish interior, including a luxurious suite, smart TVs, and an immaculate kitchen.   

Set in Gulch View -- a prime location near downtown -- this urban escape is minutes from the city’s incredible music scene, fantastic dining, shopping, and nightlife hotspots. Luxe amenities include a beautifully landscaped courtyard and a seasonal pool in the heart of the building (open from May to October, weather permitting).
Pairing contemporary style with a sustainable design, the breathtaking views from the extraordinary windows provide effortless natural light.   

LIVING AREA:
The living room includes a smart TV, a sofa, and two oversized accent chairs.

BEDROOMS:
Both bedrooms have queen beds. 

EXTRA SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: 
- 2 Plush / Memory Foam Roll Away Beds
- 1 Air Mattress 

KITCHEN:
The kitchen is fully equipped for your cooking needs! You will also find a Keurig Coffee Station that has been filled for your stay!

ILLUME Amenities:

Outdoor heated swimming pool

Furnished pool deck with gas grill

Private landscaped courtyard

Public Wi-Fi at the pool

Lounge

On-site overnight security

Other Details:

Assigned parking is available for one car in the on-site garage.

This unit is located on the second floor. Two secured elevators are available.
